info.title: relatude - command line tool for Relatude.DB
info.description: Command line tool for Relatude.DB: inspect the datamodel, run queries, generate model code and run maintenance on a local database.

options.name: --out
options.description: write one file (default: stdout)

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: write one file per node type and relation

options.name: --no-attributes
options.description: leave the attributes out

options.name: --include-native
options.description: include the engine's own model in the output

options.name: --type
options.description: only this node type or relation, repeatable

options.name: --force
options.description:
overwrite existing files
Model source (the datamodel lives in your code, not in the database files):

options.name: --project
options.description:
application folder or .csproj (default: the current folder, or the
nearest folder above it that has a relatude.db.json)

options.name: --assembly
options.description: assembly holding the model types, repeatable

options.name: --source
options.description: .cs file or folder of model source, compiled in memory, repeatable

options.name: --namespace
options.description: add every model type in this namespace, repeatable

options.name: --model-type
options.description:
add this model type by full name, and everything it references,
repeatable

options.name: --bin
options.description:
where to load the application's assemblies from, repeatable
(default: the newest build output under <project>/bin)

options.name: --no-native
options.description:
leave the engine's own model (Relatude.DB.Native.Models) out of the
datamodel, not only out of the output

options.name: --auto-deduce-relations
options.description:
treat plain node typed members without a relation as relations
When neither --namespace nor --model-type is given, the model types in the assembly are
detected by the Relatude attributes and member types they use.
Everywhere:

options.name: --json
options.description: machine readable output

options.name: --verbose
options.description: database log and full exceptions on stderr

options.name: --quiet
options.description: no diagnostics

options.name: --help
options.description:
this text
Results go to stdout, everything else to stderr. Exit code 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 wrong usage.

options.name: --format
options.description: default text

options.name: --type
options.description:
only this node type or relation, matched on short or full name,
repeatable

options.name: --ids
options.description: show the guids in text output (always present in json)

options.name: --include-native
options.description: include the engine's own model in the output

options.name: --properties-only
options.description:
skip relations
